verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing documents an in-product 'AI-powered expense assistant' and AI-powered automation of invoice entry. That shows some first-party AI working on the user's spend data inside the product, but nothing says it surfaces insights or proactive suggestions. The MCP server serves external AI assistants, so it does not count as in-product insights, and the community comments on an earlier bot experiment are too indirect to dispute the claim. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analytics on spend data, proactive recommendations or suggestions, detailed first-party docs describing the assistant's behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Save time with AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments.
